details.retiredWarning: Warning: you must be earning at least £1,300 from pension and/or pension credit.
details.mobileHelp: * We'll ask you to verify this later so please make sure you have access to your phone
details.postcodeHelp: * Enter your postcode, click 'Find' and select your address
details.acceptTermsHtml: By continuing, you agree to our use of your information. See how we use it here
details.smsMarketing: I consent to receive SMS marketing from Loans by Mal about future loan offers. You can opt out at any time.

borrow.titleBeforeAmount: You have been credit check approved to borrow up to £
borrow.body: The amount you borrow doesn’t affect your loan being accepted. As long as you can afford the monthly repayments we can pay your money out in the next 24 hours.
borrow.firstRepaymentTemplate: Your first repayment date will be {date}
borrow.futurePaymentsTemplate: All future payments will be on {date}

offer.title: Check the loan offer below and continue if you're happy
offer.bodyHtml: Based on your credit score, we can offer you the following loan, subject to affordability. If you're happy with the offer, continue to the next step and we will aim to pay your loan out in 24hrs<small> (if you're applying on a weekend, we will aim to pay out your loan the next working day)</small>
offer.continueNote: If you're happy with the loan offer, continue and tell us the account you would like the money paid into

sign.title: Read and Sign
sign.body: Please open and read through all 4 documents below. You need to read and sign the last document called 'Your Loan Agreement'. To do this type your name into the box that says 'Signature of customer' and press 'Accept'. Then click Continue at the bottom of this page.

documents.title: Explanation of Your Fixed Sum Loan Agreement

bank.title: You're all signed up and ready to go! We now need to take your payment details
bullets: After your loan is paid out your first repayment will be taken on {date}
If you want to change the loan repayment date you can arrange this after your loan is paid out
Enter the account below that you want us to pay the loan into
The account you choose must be in your name and where your income is paid
bank.repaymentDateHtml: Your loan repayment date is the 1st of each month.
bank.accountHolderConfirmed: I confirm that I am the account holder. I am authorised to set up Direct Debit payments on this account
bank.multiAuthoriser: More than one person is required to authorise payments on this account
bank.directDebitTitle: Instruction to your bank or building society to pay by Direct Debit
bank.directDebitBody: Please Pay GC re LOANS BY MAL Direct Debits from the account detailed in this Instruction subject to the safeguards assured by the Direct Debit Guarantee. I understand that this instruction may remain with GC re LOANS BY MAL and, if so, details will be passed electronically to my bank/building society.
guaranteeBullets: This Guarantee is offered by all banks and building societies that accept instructions to pay Direct Debits.
If there are any changes to the amount, date or frequency of your Direct Debit GoCardless will notify you 3 working days in advance of your account being debited or as otherwise agreed.

If an error is made in the payment of your Direct Debit, by GoCardless or your bank or building society, you are entitled to a full and immediate refund of the amount paid from your bank or building society.
You can cancel a Direct Debit at any time by simply contacting your bank or building society. Written confirmation may be required. Please also notify us.
bank.gocardlessHtml: Direct Debit Payments by GoCardless. Read the GoCardless privacy policy

affordability.title: Affordability check
noticeBullets: Your answers will help us ensure the loan repayments are affordable for you
We just need to know what you pay towards the total costs below out of your income, not the total spend as a household.
If you don't pay anything or less than we expect, that's fine, just select a reason why
affordability.monthlyIncomeHelp: * Enter the total amount of income you receive after tax, this includes all types of income except benefits
affordability.lowContributionPlaceholder: This is less than we expect, please confirm the reason why
affordability.transportLegend: Do you pay towards transport costs?
affordability.acceptTerms: I can confirm nothing is due to happen that could impact the income I receive, or cause my spending to increase, while I'm repaying the loan

card.title: Repaying your loan
card.body: Please provide a debit card as a back-up payment method, should your Direct Debit ever fail
bullets: We'll only attempt your card in the event your Direct Debit is unsuccessful
The card must be in your name and we can't accept credit cards
Once added, we won't be able to access or see your card details, the information is safe and encrypted
card.help: If you are having difficulties verifying your card, when the 60 second timer has finished, please use the skip button

openBanking.title: Last step, this bits's really fast!
openBanking.body: We need to verify the bank account you want your loan paid into. This must be the account your income is paid into. Please click continue and follow the instructions. As soon as you have verified your bank account you will have finished your loan application.
bullets: Simply click Continue and follow the prompts
Supporting information is sent instantly and securely
openBanking.bodyHtml: Consents.Online is powered by OpenBanking, a free and secure service, which keeps you safe when sharing banking transaction data. We will not have access to your money, and cannot make changes to your account. It's safe and secure. Find out more
openBanking.trustedHtml: Trusted and integrated with most major banks

verify.title: Congratulations you've completed your application
verify.body: You now need to verify the bank account that you want us to pay the money into. The account needs to be a UK bank account in your name. This should also be the account your salary is paid into.
verify.help: If you have any problems verifying your account, don’t worry, our customer support team will be in touch to help you.
verify.finalChecks: Once you’ve connected your account we’ll complete our final checks and payout the money within 24 hours.
